Breakdown: the full pass compresses lines 2-3 into 166.2-167.3 s; windows from the focused pass (timing/focus/whisper_lead_breakdown.json, production log 2). Pre-chorus 1|0 and 2|0: Whisper hears 'Rate limit' as 'Radial energy' / 'Radling it' (no anchor); windows from those mishearings' times (76.56 s; 133.74 s) up to the next line's anchor.
